publication.publisher_or_container: Composed 1258 CE; public-domain English translations include James Ross (1900, Project Gutenberg) and Edward Eastwick
publication.edition: Persian prose and verse; multiple translations

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed composition year 1258, the prose-and-verse structure, and Sa'di's own framing that bitter advice is mixed with the honey of wit. Library of Congress and Wikipedia records corroborate. Technique described, no copyrighted translation reproduced.

limitations: Persian wordplay and the alternating prose/verse structure are only partially recoverable; 'seventy-two meanings' tradition signals dense ambiguity lost in translation.

copyright.notes: 1258 Persian text public domain; nineteenth-century English translations also public domain; only paraphrase used.
